alsoTry.name: Matakichi
alsoTry.note: The restaurant's casual sister shop nearby on the same street in Gion, known for shaved ice (kakigori), open 11am to 3pm and 5pm to 10pm

bookingOpens: First-time guests can book only online, through TableCheck, where the course is paid in advance. Bookings made by a third party on someone else's behalf are cancelled with a fee.
cancellation: The cancellation fee is set out on the booking confirmation page. A booking may be cancelled if guests arrive more than 30 minutes late.
groups: Private tatami rooms seat up to 4 on the ground floor and up to 8 upstairs; online bookings take up to nine people.
duration: Lunch starts at 12pm and guests leave by 2pm.
